# Coral cod

Type: Fish | Internal ID: fish8 | Source: Fishing | Usage: Decoration | Cooking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Coral cod are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters of the Ocean biome. The schools can be in the middle of the Ocean or sometimes near other biomes' shores. This is currently the highest 'tier' fish in terms of fishing bait progression.
They can be caught with a Fishing rod using Heavy fishing bait which can be made at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Serpent trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

## Notes

• Has a unique line: "Do you ever wonder what lurks in the deepest parts of the ocean? Don't. It's better not to know."

Categorias: Fish, Fishing
